new_katakana_loans_pipeline.mechanism: Automated transliteration and phonetic normalization of incoming international terms (e.g. generative AI -> ジェネレーティブAI, prompt engineering -> プロンプトエンジニアリング, drone -> ドローン).

neologisms.etymology: Derived from 'w' (warai 笑い) resembling grass lawn; indicates laughter / lol.
Derived from English 'emotional' + Japanese i-adjective inflection; deeply moving/nostalgic.
Productive suffixation to adjectives/nouns (わかりみが深い = profound understanding).

kanji_reform_monitoring.agency: Agency for Cultural Affairs (文化庁 Bunkachō)
kanji_reform_monitoring.tracking: Revisions to official Jōyō Kanji lists and Cabinet notifications on Okurigana standards.

digital_registers_and_orthography.katakana_emphasis: Switching native words into katakana to convey mechanical, detached, or heightened emphasis (e.g. スゴイ instead of すごい, マジで instead of まじで).

continuous_learning_telemetry.monitoring: KL divergence tracking, vocabulary exhaustion metrics, and daily neologism absorption without engine downtime.
